subtitle: See every player's Blue Tiers rank directly above their nametag — in real time, on any server.

features.title: Live Tier Labels
features.desc: Displays Blue Tiers directly above nametags — instantly readable while in combat.

features.title: Full Ranking System
features.desc: Supports every gamemode ranking in the Blue Tiers system, shown at a glance.

features.title: Auto-Fetch
features.desc: Automatically pulls the latest tier data so you never play with stale rankings.

features.title: In-Game Player Profile
features.desc: View any player's full Blue Tiers profile, region, and points without leaving Minecraft.

features.title: Lightweight & Clean
features.desc: Zero performance overhead. Designed to blend with any texture pack or UI layout.

features.title: Universal Compatibility
features.desc: Client-side Fabric mod — works on any multiplayer server without server-side setup.

steps.title: Install Fabric Loader
steps.desc: Download and run the Fabric installer for your Minecraft version from fabricmc.net.

steps.title: Drop the Mod In
steps.desc: Place the Blue Tier Tagger .jar into your .minecraft/mods folder.

steps.title: Launch Minecraft
steps.desc: Select the Fabric profile in your launcher and launch. Tiers appear automatically.

ctaBody: Download Blue Tier Tagger and start seeing every player's rank in-game. Requires Fabric Loader.
ctaNote: Free forever · Fabric mod · Client-side only
aboutBody: Blue Tiers is a competitive Minecraft PvP ranking platform designed to provide accurate, reliable player rankings across multiple gamemodes. Compete against other players, climb the leaderboards, and showcase your skill — now visible directly in-game with Blue Tier Tagger.
countdownSubtext: Blue Tier Tagger is almost here. Stay tuned.
